content.what_it_is: MATLAB extraction script (OSU runup benchmark BM2; header '% a try' L1) that reads FUNWAVE-TVD gridded snapshot output and produces the gauge/ADV time-series files consumed by the plot_* scripts. Reads bathymetry ../input/depth.txt (L5); grid dx=dy=0.1 m, output interval dt=0.2 s (L7-9); axes x=[0:mx-1]*0.1-5, y=[0:ny-1]*0.1-13 (L10-13). Defines 20 gauge/ADV coordinates yg/xg (L21-43): wave gauges 1-6 at y=0, 7-12 at y=5, 13-17 along x=25, ADV points 18 (0,13), 19 (0,21), 20 (-5,21). Interactive prompt 'update igjg, yes =1' (L45): if yes, nearest-grid-index search maps (xg,yg) to (ig,jg) (L47-69) and saves igjg.mat (L71), else loads cached igjg.mat (L73). Snapshot loop kt=1:nt (nt=224, L19; L76-106): loads eta_XXXX, u_XXXX, v_XXXX from fdir='/Users/fengyanshi/tmp/' (L77-80); time1(kt)=(kt-1)*dt (L82); computes vertical-velocity proxies at two levels hh1=0.03+dep, hh2=0.01+dep (L86-87) via w=-diff(h*u)/dx-diff(h*v)/dy (L88-93); samples zg1/ug1/vg1 at gauge indices (L96-98) and wg1 using w1 for gauge 18, w2 otherwise (L99-103). Assembles output tables: FSE_BM2_shi with time + eta at gauges 1,3,6,7,9,12,13,15,17 (L108-117); VT_A/B/C_BM2_shi with time,u,v,w at ADV points 18/19/20 (L119-132). Saves four ASCII files FSE_BM2_shi_tvd.txt, VT_A/B/C_BM2_shi_tvd.txt (L134-137). break at L139 stops the script; dead code afterwards saves a model struct to model_bench2.mat (L141-147) and draws quick-look figures for all gauges and ADVs (L150-188); commented plotting remnants (L190-195).

calls: clear all @L2; load @L5, @L73, @L78, @L79, @L80; size @L6; meshgrid @L14; input @L45; abs @L50, @L61; save @L71, @L134-137, @L147; sprintf @L77; diff @L88-91; break @L139; figure @L150, @L157, @L164, @L171; subplot @L152, @L159, @L166, @L172-186; plot @L153, @L160, @L167, @L173-187; grid @L154 etc.; num2str @L152
unresolved: w computation (L88-93): both divx and divy come from diff() with no dimension argument, differencing along the first (row/y) dimension for both terms -- so w=-diff_y(h*u)/dx-diff_y(h*v)/dy rather than a proper 2D divergence; also diff shortens the first dimension by 1 while sampling still uses full-grid indices jg (L100-102), a 1-row misalignment.
The kg==18 special case uses the deeper level w1 (hh1=0.03+dep) while all others use w2 (hh2=0.01+dep) (L99-103) -- ADV elevation rationale not in the file.
hh1/hh2 add constants to the full depth array; interpretation (sensor heights above bed 3 cm/1 cm?) is not stated.
break at L139 makes L141-188 (model_bench2.mat save and quick-look figures) dead code in modern MATLAB script context break is also illegal outside a loop.
sk (L18), v (L16), X,Y (L14) and windowsize (L84, reassigned every iteration) are unused in the live part; fdir is a hard-coded personal path (L3).
FSE output selects gauges 1,3,6,7,9,12,13,15,17 (L109-117) to form 9 columns matching the WG1-9 comparison in plot_WG.m; mapping justified only implicitly.

nearest-index search (L47-69) leaves ig/jg undefined for gauges outside the axis ranges; no guard; igjg.mat cache can silently go stale when the grid changes (only the interactive flag L45 controls refresh).
